text: ‼️ 🇮🇹 JEFF EKHATOR COULD LEAVE JUVENTUS ON LOAN IN JANUARY, WITH PARMA AND SASSUOLO AMONG THE INTERESTED CLUBS A potential departure for Juventus striker Jeff Ekhator during the January transfer window should not be ruled out. The young Italian forward could benefit from a loan move that would allow him to gain more consistent playing time and continue his development. A possible destination could be a club fighting to avoid relegation and looking to strengthen its attacking options. Parma and Sassuolo have already enquired about Ekhator’s availability, although they are not the only clubs interested in securing his services. 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — NicoSchira YouTube 𝓥𝓲𝓪 — Pueblo_Juve

‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: KHÉPHREN THURAM — TARGETING MID-JANUARY RETURN Khéphren Thuram has completed his rehabilitation programme at J-Medical and is expected to return to training at Continassa next week. The French midfielder will initially work in the gym before gradually returning to running exercises on the pitch. Following the Christmas break and a medical consultation in France, Spalletti hopes to have Thuram available by mid-January, potentially for the match against Genoa. However, the Juventus medical staff remain determined to exercise maximum caution throughout his recovery. 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — tuttosport

‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: MANUEL LOCATELLI — NOT EXPECTED BACK BEFORE MARCH Juventus captain Manuel Locatelli continues to struggle with the effects of his meniscus injury. The Italian midfielder is not expected to return to full team training before March, leaving Spalletti without an important midfield option for an extended period. As a result, Juventus are reportedly considering a third signing during the January transfer window. The club could look to recruit a ready-made deep-lying playmaker capable of organising the midfield alongside Douglas Luiz, providing an immediate solution during Locatelli's absence. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮— tuttosport

‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: KENAN YILDIZ - RETURN TARGETED FOR 3rd JANUARY Kenan Yildiz has already spent two weeks completing individual training sessions with the ball, providing encouraging signs in his recovery. Despite the positive progress, Juventus have decided not to rush him back for the match against Monza on 14 December. Instead, the Bianconeri have reportedly identified the away fixture against Bologna on 3 January 2027 as his target return date. The priority remains ensuring Yildiz is fully recovered before returning to competitive action. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — tuttosport

🚨 🇧🇦 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: KERIM ALAJBEGOVIĆ A DOUBT FOR OMONIA CLASH Kerim Alajbegović experienced discomfort in his shin during Juventus’ match against Venezia, raising concerns about his availability for the upcoming Europa League fixture against Omonia. The young Bosnian midfielder’s condition will need to be assessed in the coming days, with his participation in Thursday’s match currently uncertain.
